biotools.summary: NANOTAXI is a Shiny-based GUI designed for the automated, real-time taxonomic classification and analysis of 16S rRNA gene sequences generated by Oxford Nanopore sequencing. It provides an integrated platform for microbiome analysis, supporting various classifiers and functional inference.
